# Synthetic FR-DA content fixtures

`course.synthetic.json` is a tiny fictional fixture for the version-1 contract in `docs/JSON_FORMAT.md`. It is not reviewed linguistic content and must not be promoted to production.

It contains one Level 1 test lesson and one Children test lesson, each with four items and two quiz questions. It exercises bilingual display, `da-DK` TTS, all optional note types, stable progress IDs, quiz data, and explicit Children routing.
